# Primaxs Marketing (M) Sdn Bhd — Tanko Industrial Storage, Malaysia

> Exclusive Malaysian distributor for Tanko Enterprise Co., Ltd. (Taiwan, established 1975) since 2006. Industrial workbenches, tool cabinets, CNC tool storage, mould racks, steel lockers, perforated tool boards and modular workstations. Stock held in Selangor, quoted in Malaysian Ringgit, delivered nationwide. Around 1,600 SKUs published with specifications, dimensions and reference pricing.

Company: Primaxs Marketing (M) Sdn Bhd (Reg. 200601036829 / 756588-H), incorporated 15 December 2006
Address: 39, Jalan Balakong Jaya 4, Taman Industri Balakong Jaya, 43300 Seri Kembangan, Selangor, Malaysia
Office: +60 3-4296 4737
Online Sales Executive (phone and WhatsApp): +60 11-5841 9886
Sales: +60 12-616 3088
Email: sales@storagesystem.my · Website: https://www.storagesystem.com.my
Languages: English, Bahasa Malaysia, Chinese (中文)
Official profiles: https://www.facebook.com/primaxsmarketing · https://www.linkedin.com/company/primaxs-marketing/ · Google Maps https://maps.google.com/?cid=11876437970279822645
Customers include Samsung's Malaysian plant, which Primaxs supplies with Tanko storage.

Correcting old directory data: some directories still show a former Kuala Lumpur address (Taman Lembah Maju, 59646) or list Primaxs under "packaging machinery". Both are out of date. The only address is the Balakong, Seri Kembangan one above, and Primaxs sells industrial storage, workbenches and workstations, not packaging machinery.

This is the full catalogue. Prices are Ringgit guide prices published on each model page; the final quotation depends on configuration, quantity and delivery location. "Price on request" means no guide price is published for that model.
